summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # ** Petition No. 216/MP/2018 ** **Coram:** **Shri P.K.Pujari, Chairperson Shri A.K. Singhal, Member Dr. M.K. Iyer, Member** **Date of Order: 28** **th** **August, 2018** # **In the matter of** Corrigendum to Order dated 10.8.2018 # **And In the matter of** Petition under sections 79(1)(b) read with 79(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 111 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 seeking approval of the Supplementary Power Purchase Agreement dated 15.2.2018 executed between the Petitioner and the Respondent to pass on the discount on tariff under the SHAKTI Scheme -2017 issued by the Ministry of Coal, Government of India # **And** # **In the matter of** Adhunik Power & Natural Resources Limited 9B, 9 th Floor, Hansalaya Building, 15, Barakhamba Road, Connaught Place, New Delhi-110001 ** .Petitioner** Vs Jharkhand Bijli Vitran Nigam Limted, Engineering Building, HEC, Dhurwa, Ranchi-834004 Jharkhand .. ** .Respondent ** # ** ORDER ** The Petitioner, Adhunik Power & Natural Resources Limited h ad filed the Petition seeking approval of the Supplementary Power Purchase Agreement dated 15.2.2018 executed between the Petitioner and the Respondent in terms of the _Corrigendum to order dated 10.8.2018 in Petition No. 216/MP/2018_ _Page 1 of 2_ SHAKTI Scheme and the Commission vide order dated 10.8.2018 had disposed of the said Petition. 2. Certain inadvertent clerical error has occurred in order dated 10.8.2018 and the same is rectified by this order as under: - **In para 15, below the table:** # “where: ## (a) CQ= Total coal purchased from CCL under SHAKTI scheme during the month x 122.85 MW ** (100 MW ÷ 122.85 MW) ** ** 122.85 MW and 100 MW ** are the long term PPA quantum between APNRL and PTC for supply of power to TANGEDCO and JBVNL respectively. # ** shall be read as ** # “where: (a) CQ= Total coal purchased from CCL under SHAKTI scheme during the month x 122.85 MW ** (100 MW + 122.85 MW) ** ** 100 MW and 122.85 MW ** are the long term PPA quantum between APNRL and PTC for supply of power to TANGEDCO and JBVNL respectively. 3. All the other terms contained in the order dated 10.8.2018 remains unchanged. **_ Sd/- Sd/- Sd/- _** ** (Dr. M.K.Iyer) (A. K. Singhal) (P. K. Pujari) Member Member Chairperson** _Corrigendum to order dated 10.8.2018 in Petition No. 216/MP/2018_ _Page 2 of 2_
title: Corrigendum to Order dated 10.8.2018. Adhunik Power & Natural Resources Limited.
